_purpose: File index with load policies for AI session optimization

_load_policy_values.always: Load on every session start (core context files)
_load_policy_values.summary_only: Load metadata/stats only, not full content
_load_policy_values.on_request: Load only when explicitly requested by agent
_load_policy_values.never: Deprecated/archived - do not load unless debugging

WAI-Lugs.jsonl.description: Active work and dependency graph - load stats, not full content

WAI-Guide.md.description: Full protocol documentation - agents should know this already

WAI-Challenges.jsonl.description: Improvement ideas and challenges - load when doing planning

sessions/*.jsonl.description: Session tracks - only load during historian analysis or closeout

seed/processed/*.teaching.description: Already-adopted teachings - archived for audit trail only

seed/ingest/*.teaching.description: Pending teachings to adopt - wakeup Step 3a discovery

reference/auto/*.description: Historical snapshots and backups - debugging only

reference/WAI-AI-ONBOARDING.md.description: AI interaction model and command reference

reference/WAI-MERGE-PROTOCOLS.md.description: JSON merge guidance for teaching adoption

commands/*.md.description: Skill command files - load when executing specific command

advisors/historian/*.description: Historian working files - only loaded during historian execution

_usage_notes.for_agents: Check this index on session start to understand what's loaded vs available. Use load_policy to decide whether to request additional files.
_usage_notes.for_hooks: Session start hooks should only load 'always' and compute summaries for 'summary_only' files
_usage_notes.for_commands: Commands should load 'on_request' files as needed for their specific task
_usage_notes.updating_this_file: Update when adding new file types or changing load strategies. Keep token_estimates current.
